text:
alex: Found a docs/contract mismatch for POST /v1/uploads. The API ref currently only shows application/json with a base64 `file` field. Hosted endpoint rejects that (I got 415).

alex: Broken example in PR:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/uploads \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"filename":"pic.png","file":"<base64>"}'
```

jo: Thanks — canonical for hosted should be multipart/form-data. We should update OpenAPI to accept both media types (oneOf) but render multipart-first. Move JSON/base64 to an "Alternate (Legacy)" note.

chris: Runtime note: hosted only accepts multipart. Dedicated/Private can accept JSON/base64 if the deployment has `legacy_uploads` enabled (older on-prem agents). Will confirm exact flag name.

alex: Proposed multipart cURL to replace the broken example:
```bash
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/uploads \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \n  -F "file=@./pic.png" \n  -F "filename=pic.png"
# curl adds Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=... automatically
```

nina: Add short SDK snippets too — our client libs handle multipart for you. Eg JS:```js
import client from '@redwood/sdk'
await client.uploadFile({ path: './pic.png', filename: 'pic.png' })
```

jo: Also call out hosted max file size (25 MB) and suggest streaming for larger files in examples. Add a tiny migration note for customers moving from base64 to multipart.

chris: Confirmed flag name: `legacy_uploads`. I'll add a sentence: "JSON/base64 payloads are accepted only on Dedicated/Private when `legacy_uploads` is enabled; Hosted API rejects JSON uploads." Will review PR text.

alex: I'll open the PR with OpenAPI change + three snippet variants (cURL multipart, python requests multipart, JS SDK). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/978 (WIP).

_docs-bot: Preview deployed for PR 978 https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr/978/uploads-multipart-primary. Check rendering and the legacy callout._

jo: Quick docs nits from preview: 1) show `Content-Type: multipart/form-data` as a note in the cURL code block, 2) include server error example for >25 MB (413 payload too large).

nina: Also add a one-line example for Go showing streaming upload (io.Copy) so customers don't buffer large files.

alex: Will update PR with those edits and assign reviews: jo (docs), chris (tech), nina (SDK). Merge after approvals. :thumbsup:
